population: initial27; frozen historical candidate set, not the final corrected candidate census

method.max_delta_uv: Maximum Euclidean distance in CIE 1960 (u,v) among available DESI, Gaia full and Gaia truncated nominal points; not a significance.
method.gaia_point_boundary_cross: Full and truncated nominal |Duv|>0.01 classifications differ.
method.interval_boundary_status_disagrees: Full and truncated central-95% intervals differ in being wholly outside [-0.01,0.01].
method.all_three_interval_subset: All three central-95% intervals are entirely beyond the same signed boundary. Descriptive intersection only; no pooled probability or confirmation.
method.interval_models: DESI: conditional independent-pixel noise + PS1 anchors and offset/tilt. Gaia: native coefficient covariance and formal Monte Carlo, separate full/truncated reconstructions of the SAME observation.
method.systematics: No complete calibration/contamination/truncation-bias/selection model. Full/truncated results are correlated; repeat DESI epochs share PS1.
method.missingness: Absent catalogue entries, unqueried nights and unavailable intervals are not non-detections.
method.photometry: Swan quoted PS1 errors already include rounded DR1 error plus 0.01 mag in quadrature; pipeline applies max(quoted_error,0.02), without re-adding 0.01.
method.heldout_z: Predicted minus observed PS1 z magnitude, unused in gri calibration. Absolute residual >0.05 mag is an additional diagnostic, not sigma significance; supplied pixel-only errors are not total errors.
method.baseline: Version 0.1 headline values are retained in original outputs. New error/anchor definitions explain revised estimates; these are not measurements of stellar change.
